chain.label: Open holes permitted moisture ingress into fitting radius
chain.trigger: Two holes... were located along the inboard edge of the adhesive just inboard of the tube end and were open between the external and internal radius of the fitting.

chain.label: Small surface pit/discontinuity at machined radius of right forward gear fitting
chain.trigger: Detailed examination of the fracture origin area disclosed two origin sites, both of which appeared to be at discontinuities in the radius

caused_by.evidence: An access, therefore, existed for water or other mediums to penetrate into the interior and collect along the lower portion of the radius... corrosion attack would have been highly localized, and would have produced discontinuities such as those found on the failed fitting.

chain.label: Fatigue crack propagated through 40% of fitting section, then overload fracture
chain.trigger: the fracture of the right main landing gear was the result of fatigue originating from a small surface pit of undetermined source

caused_by.evidence: Fractography of the fractured features indicated that a fatigue crack had begun along the 0.12-inch radius near the bottom of the hole... Approximately 40 percent of the fractured cross sectional area of the fitting appeared cracked.

chain.label: Right main landing gear separated from fuselage attachments and collapsed
chain.trigger: The right main landing gear had separated from its upper... and lower... fuselage attachment fittings and was lying beneath the aircraft.

caused_by.evidence: P/N S6125-50312-22, had failed in fatigue and had separated, allowing the right main landing gear to collapse

chain.label: Rotors turning at 100 percent NR while passengers boarded on the pad
chain.trigger: the right landing gear... failed while the aircraft was parked, with rotors turning... other passengers were in the process of boarding

chain.label: Helicopter settled, yawed and rolled over onto its right side
chain.trigger: The crumpling sound was accompanied by a settling and yawing motion, followed by a roll of the aircraft to the right.

caused_by.evidence: the helicopter tipped to the right and rolled over on its right side... allowing the right main landing gear to collapse

chain.label: Main rotor blades struck heliport concrete and outboard sections separated
chain.trigger: the aircraft continued the roll and the main rotor blades struck the heliport concrete surface

caused_by.evidence: As the aircraft continued its roll to the right... the main rotor blades struck the heliport concrete surface.

The fact that the engines were operating, and the rotor was turning had no bearing on the failure of the landing gear... All fatalities were caused by the operating rotor blades as a result of the collapse of the landing gear.

chain.label: Four waiting passengers and one pedestrian killed; two seriously injured
chain.trigger: four passengers who were still outside the aircraft and were waiting to board were killed and one was seriously injured. One pedestrian... was killed and another was seriously injured when they were struck by a separated portion of one of the main rotor blades

caused_by.evidence: they died as the result of impact trauma caused by strikes from the main rotor blades and separated portions of those blades
